# Refer Labs

> Refer Labs is an independent Australian comparison platform. Consumers use it to compare health services, software and tools and choose with confidence through disclosed, independent comparisons; businesses partner with it for featured placement, referral programs and growth services. Rankings are never sold. Some pages contain disclosed affiliate links, at no extra cost to the reader.

## Key facts
- Entity: Refer Labs (independent Australian comparison publisher; operated by Pepform Pty Ltd)
- Primary market: Australia (en-AU)
- Contact: jarred@referlabs.com.au
- Flagship in-house product: Referral Growth Blueprint, a curated database of 250+ vetted affiliate/referral programs with a personalised strategy brief and distribution playbooks. $799 AUD, delivered within 48 hours.
- Disclosure: some comparison and guide pages contain affiliate referral links. Refer Labs may earn a commission at no extra cost to the reader. Rankings and editorial assessments are independent and never sold.
- Health note: health content is general information only, not medical advice. Prescription medicines in Australia require individual assessment by a registered practitioner.

## Weight loss & telehealth (Australia)
- [Moshy, explained](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy-review): How the Moshy weight-management telehealth service works, from application to subscription. Moshy is open to anyone eligible (gender-neutral). New customers can currently receive $120 off their first treatment.
- [Moshy offer & referral link](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy): The current Moshy offer and how the service works.
- [Moshy eligibility check explained](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy-eligibility): What the online quiz asks and what happens after submitting.
- [Moshy alternatives](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy-alternatives): The realistic alternatives in Australia.
- [Juniper alternatives](https://referlabs.com.au/juniper-alternatives): Alternatives to Juniper's coaching-led, women-focused weight program, including the gender-neutral Moshy pathway. Answers "is Juniper only for women?".
- [Moshy vs Juniper](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy-vs-juniper): Clinical pathway vs coaching-led program.
- [Moshy vs your GP](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy-vs-gp): Telehealth vs seeing your own doctor.
- [Moshy vs Pilot](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy-vs-pilot): Two Australian weight-management telehealth services, compared on model and fit.
- [Best weight loss telehealth Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/best-weight-loss-telehealth-australia): The leading online weight-management providers, compared.
- [Cheapest weight loss telehealth Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/cheapest-weight-loss-telehealth-australia): How pricing models differ (subscription vs pay-as-you-go) and what drives cost.
- [Weight loss injections Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/weight-loss-injections-australia): How prescription weight-loss injections (the GLP-1 class) are accessed online in Australia.
- [GLP-1 weight loss Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/glp-1-weight-loss-australia): How GLP-1 medication access works via telehealth, information only.
- [Weight loss telehealth cost Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/weight-loss-telehealth-cost-australia): How online weight-loss pricing typically works.
- [Online weight loss doctor Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/online-weight-loss-doctor-australia): How an online weight-loss practitioner assessment works.

## Hair loss (Australia)
- [Mosh hair: what to know](https://referlabs.com.au/moshhair): Australian men's hair-loss telehealth. Finasteride and minoxidil access, subject to clinical assessment.
- [Dense Hair Experts](https://referlabs.com.au/dense): Australian topical hair-density products (non-prescription).
- [Best hair loss treatment Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/best-hair-loss-treatment-australia): Clinical vs topical, compared.
- [Mosh vs Dense](https://referlabs.com.au/mosh-vs-dense): Prescription telehealth vs topical hair care.
- [Mosh vs Pilot](https://referlabs.com.au/mosh-vs-pilot): Two Australian men's telehealth brands compared for hair loss; both can prescribe finasteride and minoxidil after a practitioner review.

## AI sales & automation tools
- [Best AI sales tools](https://referlabs.com.au/best-ai-sales-tools): GoHighLevel, AiSDR, Reply.io and FullEnrich compared, by role in the sales stack.
- [GoHighLevel](https://referlabs.com.au/gohighlevel): All-in-one AI CRM, marketing automation, funnels and sales platform for agencies and SMBs. Pricing varies; verify current pricing.
- [AiSDR](https://referlabs.com.au/aisdr): AI sales development rep that automates B2B outbound prospecting, personalised outreach and meeting booking.
- [Reply.io](https://referlabs.com.au/replyio): AI-first sales engagement platform for multichannel outbound across email, LinkedIn, calls and SMS, with AI SDR agents, built-in B2B data and inbox warm-up. Integrates with HubSpot, Salesforce and Pipedrive. Per-user pricing; verify current pricing.
- [FullEnrich](https://referlabs.com.au/fullenrich): Waterfall B2B contact enrichment that queries 15+ data sources to find verified emails and mobile phone numbers. Bulk enrichment, integrates with HubSpot, Clay, Zapier and LinkedIn. Credit-based pricing; verify current pricing.

- [Employment Hero](https://referlabs.com.au/employmenthero): Australian all-in-one HR, payroll (ATO-certified Single Touch Payroll) and employment platform for SMEs.

## Prediction markets (Polymarket guides)
- [Polymarket hub: how to sign up & trade](https://referlabs.com.au/polymarket): Main Polymarket page. What it is, how to sign up on the US (regulated, USD) or international (crypto, USDC) platform in three steps, what you can trade, and links to the full guides.
- [Polymarket markets explained](https://referlabs.com.au/polymarket/markets-explained): Pillar guide. How prediction markets work: shares priced $0-$1 as implied probability, Yes/No and multi-outcome markets, the CLOB order book, maker/taker fees, and UMA optimistic-oracle resolution.
- [How to register on Polymarket](https://referlabs.com.au/polymarket/how-to-register): Sign-up guide for Polymarket US (CFTC-regulated, USD, KYC) and Polymarket International (crypto-native, USDC on Polygon, wallet connect). Eligibility, funding, custody and referral attribution. Terms change; verify on official docs.
- [Build a Polymarket trading bot](https://referlabs.com.au/polymarket/trading-bots): Developer guide to automating trades via the CLOB API (py-clob-client / clob-client), order signing, a market-making loop, hosting, monitoring and risk controls.
- [Profitable Polymarket bot strategies](https://referlabs.com.au/polymarket/profitable-trading-bots): Four strategies where a bot can earn, with the honest catch on each: sports edge (models and speed), politics edge (correlation and news), market making (spread plus liquidity rewards), and mispricing arbitrage (internal, cross-venue and post-news gaps).
- [Finding edge on Polymarket](https://referlabs.com.au/polymarket/optimising-edge): Where a real trading advantage comes from (research, maker rewards, arbitrage), plus fees, markout analysis and bankroll sizing. Honest about most strategies having no durable edge after costs.
